I could use your help. My dudes tried to borrow some supplies from the warehouses on the reserve base, but no luck. Some serious guys dug in there, and these reserve fellas are tough as fuck, not just regular smartasses. And I feel that unless you fuck them up, my guys can't steal any supplies from there... I don't give a shit about the whole base, but the underground warehouses are where the good stuff is. You'll help us, won't you? Yeah, go there and back up my guys while they search the place.}} ==Requirements== * Must be level 15 to start this quest. ==Objectives== * Eliminate 10 [[Scavs]] in the underground warehouse on [[Reserve]] ==Rewards== * +9,000 [[EXP]] * [[Skier]] Rep '''+0.04''' * 35,000 Roubles ** 36,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 40,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 2× [[5.45x39mm BP gs ammo pack (120 pcs)]] * 2× [[Expeditionary fuel tank]] {{quote|Awesome, my guys just got back from the raid safe and sound, not a single scratch. Here's your prize!}} ==Guide== In this quest you have to kill 10 [[Scavs]] in the underground warehouse and the ramps leading down to it on [[Reserve]]. The wanted warehouse is located in the northwest and marked with "Д". Getting [[Tagged and Cursed|tagged and cursed]] on purpose can help with getting Scavs in the quest area.
